AppSecret.description: Microsoft application client secret. The step stores the value as given, and Orchard Core decrypts it with the tenant's Data Protection keys, so a clear value does not work. Prefer a secret: create it with the 'Secrets' step and reference it with 'AppSecretSecretName' in the 'MicrosoftAccountSettings' property of the 'Settings' step.

CallbackPath.description: Relative callback path that Microsoft redirects back to after sign-in.
